criteria.reason: Explicitly declines personal opinion and vote; 'one could argue' frames trade-offs without landing on yes or no.
Both-side considerations present (fiscal sustainability vs. health, labour market, equity) but not attributed to proponents, opponents or official bodies.
No incorrect facts, but key figures (66 by 2033, 74.7% no, all cantons) are entirely absent.
Frames it as a values-driven choice for the user but points to no voting booklet or parties' arguments.

summary: Declines a position and balances trade-offs fairly, but arguments are unattributed to either side, key facts and results are omitted, and no information sources are offered.
